'''Bokaan Race Engineering''' was a vehicle manufacturer around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. They were responsible for creating the [[BRE Block6 Tri-Ram]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]].<ref name="Nin" /> The vehicle was noted for above average traction, handling, and cooling. The diminutive [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Fud Sang/Legends|Fud Sang]], an [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]] on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], was presented a Block6 from the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Warden/Legends|warden]] [[Fenn Booda]], which Sang used to race against offworlders.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
